name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the intricate designs of Formula 1 cars. He was particularly drawn to the complex carbon fiber components. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Universiti Teknologi Malaysia, he secured an apprenticeship with a local racing team, specializing in composite materials. His keen eye for detail and relentless pursuit of perfection quickly set him apart. 

Over the years, Ahmad has honed his skills in the fabrication and repair of composite parts, working with various racing teams and manufacturers. He's known for his ability to troubleshoot complex issues quickly and efficiently, often devising innovative solutions to improve performance and durability. While he values collaboration, Ahmad is most comfortable working independently, often finding creative solutions when left to his own devices. His commitment to quality and his ability to push the boundaries of composite technology make him a valuable asset to any team.

physical.description: Ahmad is of average height with a wiry build, reflecting years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
Prefers working in silence and uses noise-canceling headphones even when there's no noise.
